description: Starts a conversion. Give the target (`to`: a format name such as glb, fbx, obj, stl, ply, dae, usdz, 3mf, or a mesh tool kind from list_tools such as mesh-decimate) and the file as an https link (`file_url`) or as the file attached to the chat (`file`). The source format is read from the file name; pass `from` for a .zip. `options` are the mesh tool's parameters (for example { targetFaces: 10000, format: "glb" }). Answers with a job id to poll with job_status.

file.description: The file attached to the chat

file_name.description: The file's name with its extension, when the link does not end in one

file_url.description: An https link to the file

from.description: Source format name; required when the file is a .zip

to.description: Target format name, or a mesh tool kind from list_tools

name: convert_file
title: Convert a 3D file
